```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

crashes <- read_rds("data/nyc_collisions_clean.rds")
```

```{r}
crashes_analysis <- crashes |>
  mutate(
    # Outcomes
    injury_crash = number_of_persons_injured > 0,
    fatal_crash = number_of_persons_killed > 0,

    # Time
    year = year(crash_date),
    month = month(crash_date, label = TRUE),
    day_of_week = wday(crash_date, label = TRUE),

    # Keep original crash_time unchanged
    hour = as.integer(str_sub(crash_time, 1, 2)),

    weekend = day_of_week %in% c("Sat", "Sun"),
    night = hour < 6 | hour >= 20,
    rush_hour = hour %in% c(7, 8, 9, 16, 17, 18)
  )
```

```{r}
crashes_analysis <- crashes_analysis |>
  mutate(
    speeding = contributing_factor_vehicle_1 == "Unsafe Speed",

    alcohol = contributing_factor_vehicle_1 == "Alcohol Involvement",

    distracted = contributing_factor_vehicle_1 %in% c(
      "Driver Inattention/Distraction",
      "Outside Car Distraction",
      "Passenger Distraction",
      "Other Electronic Device",
      "Cell Phone (Hand-Held)",
      "Cell Phone (hands-free)",
      "Texting",
      "Using On Board Navigation Device",
      "Eating or Drinking",
      "Listening/Using Headphones"
    ),

    fatigued = contributing_factor_vehicle_1 %in% c(
      "Fatigued/Drowsy",
      "Fell Asleep"
    ),

    aggressive_driving = contributing_factor_vehicle_1 %in% c(
      "Aggressive Driving/Road Rage",
      "Passing or Lane Usage Improper",
      "Passing Too Closely",
      "Unsafe Lane Changing"
    ),

    traffic_violation = contributing_factor_vehicle_1 %in% c(
      "Failure to Yield Right-of-Way",
      "Traffic Control Disregarded",
      "Failure to Keep Right"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
crashes_analysis <- crashes_analysis |>
  unite(
    "vehicle_types",
    starts_with("vehicle_type_code_"),
    sep = " | ",
    remove = FALSE,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    vehicle_types = str_to_lower(vehicle_types),

    bicycle_involved = str_detect(
      vehicle_types,
      "bike|bicycle|e-bike"
    ),

    motorcycle_involved = str_detect(
      vehicle_types,
      "motorcycle|motorbike|moped|scooter"
    ),

    truck_involved = str_detect(
      vehicle_types,
      "truck|tractor|tanker|flat bed|flat rack|chassis|garbage|refuse"
    ),

    bus_involved = str_detect(
      vehicle_types,
      "bus"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
crashes_analysis <- crashes_analysis |>
  mutate(
    severity_score =
      0.5 * number_of_persons_injured +
      number_of_persons_killed
  )

crashes_analysis |>
  summarise(
    mean_severity = mean(severity_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_severity = median(severity_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_severity = max(severity_score, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

crashes_analysis |>
  count(severity_score, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
time_summary <- bind_rows(
  crashes_analysis |>
    group_by(night) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      injury_rate = mean(injury_crash, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      fatal_rate = mean(fatal_crash, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      mean_severity = mean(severity_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      category = if_else(night, "Night", "Day"),
      variable = "Time of Day"
    ) |>
    select(variable, category, n, injury_rate, fatal_rate, mean_severity),

  crashes_analysis |>
    group_by(weekend) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      injury_rate = mean(injury_crash, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      fatal_rate = mean(fatal_crash, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      mean_severity = mean(severity_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      category = if_else(weekend, "Weekend", "Weekday"),
      variable = "Day Type"
    ) |>
    select(variable, category, n, injury_rate, fatal_rate, mean_severity),

  crashes_analysis |>
    group_by(rush_hour) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      injury_rate = mean(injury_crash, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      fatal_rate = mean(fatal_crash, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      mean_severity = mean(severity_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      category = if_else(rush_hour, "Rush Hour", "Non-Rush Hour"),
      variable = "Rush Hour"
    ) |>
    select(variable, category, n, injury_rate, fatal_rate, mean_severity)
)

time_summary
```

```{r}
injury_model_1 <- glm(
  injury_crash ~
    night +
    weekend +
    rush_hour +
    factor(year) +
    borough,
  data = crashes_analysis,
  family = binomial
)
```

```{r}
injury_model_2 <- glm(
  injury_crash ~
    night +
    weekend +
    rush_hour +
    factor(year) +
    borough +
    speeding +
    alcohol +
    distracted +
    fatigued +
    aggressive_driving +
    traffic_violation,
  data = crashes_analysis,
  family = binomial
)
```

```{r}
injury_model_3 <- glm(
  injury_crash ~
    night +
    weekend +
    rush_hour +
    factor(year) +
    borough +
    speeding +
    alcohol +
    distracted +
    fatigued +
    aggressive_driving +
    traffic_violation +
    bicycle_involved +
    motorcycle_involved +
    truck_involved +
    bus_involved,
  data = crashes_analysis,
  family = binomial
)
```

```{r}
summary(injury_model_3)
```

```{r}
library(broom)
injury_results <- tidy(
  injury_model_3,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
fatal_model_interaction <- glm(
  fatal_crash ~
    night * speeding +
    weekend +
    rush_hour +
    factor(year) +
    borough +
    alcohol +
    distracted +
    fatigued +
    aggressive_driving +
    traffic_violation +
    bicycle_involved +
    motorcycle_involved +
    truck_involved +
    bus_involved,
  data = crashes_analysis,
  family = binomial
)
```

```{r}
tidy(
  fatal_model_interaction,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
) |>
  filter(
    term %in% c(
      "nightTRUE",
      "speedingTRUE",
      "nightTRUE:speedingTRUE"
    )
  ) |>
  select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
```

```{r}
model_comparison <- injury_results_clean |>
  select(term, injury_or = estimate) |>
  left_join(
    fatal_results_clean |>
      select(term, fatal_or = estimate),
    by = "term"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    term = str_remove(term, "TRUE"),
    term = recode(
      term,
      night = "Night",
      weekend = "Weekend",
      rush_hour = "Rush Hour",
      speeding = "Speeding",
      alcohol = "Alcohol",
      distracted = "Distracted",
      fatigued = "Fatigued",
      aggressive_driving = "Aggressive Driving",
      traffic_violation = "Traffic Violation",
      bicycle_involved = "Bicycle Involved",
      motorcycle_involved = "Motorcycle / Scooter Involved",
      truck_involved = "Truck Involved",
      bus_involved = "Bus Involved"
    )
  )

model_comparison
```

```{r}
or_plot_data <- bind_rows(
  injury_results_clean |>
    mutate(outcome = "Injury"),

  fatal_results_clean |>
    mutate(outcome = "Fatality")
) |>
  mutate(
    term = str_remove(term, "TRUE"),
    term = recode(
      term,
      night = "Night",
      weekend = "Weekend",
      rush_hour = "Rush Hour",
      speeding = "Speeding",
      alcohol = "Alcohol",
      distracted = "Distracted",
      fatigued = "Fatigued",
      aggressive_driving = "Aggressive Driving",
      traffic_violation = "Traffic Violation",
      bicycle_involved = "Bicycle Involved",
      motorcycle_involved = "Motorcycle / Scooter Involved",
      truck_involved = "Truck Involved",
      bus_involved = "Bus Involved"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  or_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = estimate,
    y = reorder(term, estimate),
    shape = outcome
  )
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = conf.low,
      xmax = conf.high
    ),
    height = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Factors Associated with Injury and Fatality",
    subtitle = "Adjusted odds ratios from logistic regression models",
    x = "Odds Ratio (log scale)",
    y = NULL,
    shape = "Outcome"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
injury_predictions <- augment(
  injury_model_3,
  type.predict = "response"
)

fatal_predictions <- augment(
  fatal_model,
  type.predict = "response"
)

library(pROC)

injury_roc <- roc(
  injury_predictions$injury_crash,
  injury_predictions$.fitted
)

fatal_roc <- roc(
  fatal_predictions$fatal_crash,
  fatal_predictions$.fitted
)

auc(injury_roc)
auc(fatal_roc)
```
